posts.post:
there is no middle ground.

either you’re a 'one bag for life' person or you lose your charger every three days.

nothing worse than buying a 'premium' hoodie that loses its shape after three washes.

who else is tired of this cycle?

ironing a tee is a crime.

either the fabric sits right on its own, or it’s not worth wearing.

we spent six months fighting over the collar thickness on our new drop.

most people won't notice, but some will.
